# Performance Checklist: Shopping Lists

**Purpose**: Check that the performance requirements (cold start, tick latency, scrolling, data size) are complete, clear, consistent and measurable, and that their measurement conditions are reproducible, before implementation starts
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), with [plan.md](../plan.md) (Performance Goals), [research.md](../research.md) R4, R9 and R11, [quickstart.md](../quickstart.md) §5 steps 4, 11 and 12, and [tasks.md](../tasks.md) T129 and T135

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Audience and depth**: reviewer, standard depth, used as a gate before `/speckit-implement`. Durability (FR-028, SC-007) is covered by [data.md](data.md), accessibility timings by [ux.md](ux.md), and error tracking delivery (SC-010) by [observability.md](observability.md); they are not repeated here.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK001 - Is the stop point of SC-001's 2-second clock defined unambiguously: the moment the list is drawn, the moment the tap lands, or the moment the tick is visible, and does it include the tester's own reaction time between seeing the list and tapping? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK002 - Is "within 100 ms of the tap" (SC-002) anchored to a defined event (finger down or finger up), consistent with quickstart step 11, which counts from "the finger touching the screen"? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002, Quickstart §5 step 11]
- [x] CHK003 - Is "visible" in SC-002 defined (check mark drawn, strike-through drawn, row moved to the ticked group), given a ticked row also moves within its section (FR-005)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK004 - Is "frames dropped" in SC-008 defined with one meaning (frames missing their deadline, Android "janky frames", iOS hitches), so the same figure is read on both platforms? [Clarity, Spec §SC-008, Quickstart §5 step 11]
- [x] CHK005 - Is "55 frames per second" stated against a display refresh rate, given a phone with a 90 or 120 Hz screen makes 55 fps a large drop rather than a near-60 result? [Clarity, Assumption, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK006 - Does SC-008 say whether the 50 ticks happen during the 10-second scroll or as a separate run, and whether the frame-rate figure covers the ticks too? [Clarity, Spec §SC-008]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK007 - Do the Edge Cases ("200 or more items on one list: scrolling and ticking meet SC-008") and the Assumptions ("performance is not promised beyond them") agree on whether SC-008 holds above 200 items? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK008 - Do SC-002 and SC-008 state the same tick-latency rule (95% of 50 ticks within 100 ms at 200 items) on purpose, and is it clear which one a measurement satisfies, or should one refer to the other? [Consistency, Duplication, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK009 - Does the measurement method for SC-008 agree between research R11 (React Native Perf Monitor) and quickstart step 11 (`adb shell dumpsys gfxinfo` and Xcode Instruments)? [Conflict, Research §R11, Quickstart §5 step 11]
- [x] CHK010 - Does the plan's wording of SC-001 ("current list usable within 2 s") match the spec's (list shown and a tap ticks an item), so no reader can satisfy the plan's version without the spec's? [Consistency, Plan §Performance Goals, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the Clarifications answer that sets SC-008 "with each tick shown within 100 ms" reconciled with the later answer that allows 5% of ticks over 100 ms? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §SC-008]

## Measurement Conditions and Reproducibility

- [x] CHK012 - Are the two reference phones identified precisely enough to repeat a measurement (model, system version), or is "an entry-level Android phone about five years old" accepted as the whole definition? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK013 - Is the build used for measurement specified (EAS profile, with or without the Sentry DSN, Hermes release bundle), given the measurement seed build and the `preview` build differ and Sentry initialization runs at startup? [Gap, Spec §SC-001, Tasks §T135, Quickstart §5 step 11]
- [x] CHK014 - Are the device conditions during measurement stated (battery saver off, theme, system text size, screen reader off, other apps closed, network state for SC-002 "with or without network")? [Gap, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK015 - Is the shape of the measurement data defined beyond counts: how many of the 200 items are ticked, how they spread over categories, how long the names are (row height varies with wrapping, FR-022), and whether items have quantities? [Gap, Tasks §T135, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK016 - Is it stated how many items the 19 other lists hold in the measurement data, given "200 items per list" is a stated size and the total number of list items affects storage reads? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions, Tasks §T135]
- [x] CHK017 - Is the timing method for SC-001 specified (stopwatch, screen recording, slow-motion video), as it is for ticks in quickstart step 11? [Gap, Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Quickstart §5 step 12]
- [x] CHK018 - Is the procedure for the 10 launches of SC-001 defined (how the app is fully stopped, whether the phone is restarted between runs, whether the first launch after install counts)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001, Quickstart §5 step 12]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK019 - Are response-time requirements defined for the add screen at full catalog size: opening it with 1 000 articles and filtering as each letter is typed in search (accent and œ/æ folding, FR-009)? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK020 - Are response-time requirements defined for actions shown only after their save (adding, removing, setting a quantity, creating an article, a category or a list, choosing the current list), or is "no target" an explicit decision? [Gap, Spec §FR-028, Research §R9]
- [x] CHK021 - Is a time limit defined for "Terminer les courses" on a 200-item list, an action that changes every ticked item in one transaction and shows nothing before its save? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, Research §R9a]
- [x] CHK022 - Is a time limit defined for switching the current list (SC-005 counts taps, not time) and for opening the screen of my lists with 20 lists? [Gap, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK023 - Is the first launch (empty storage, migration and seeding of the default categories and "Ma liste", FR-023) covered by a start-time requirement, or explicitly excluded from SC-001? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK024 - Is start time after an application update that runs a migration covered, or explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-040]
- [x] CHK025 - Are warm start and return from the background addressed, or is the exclusion of anything but a cold start stated as a decision rather than left unsaid? [Coverage, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK026 - Is the effect of quick repeated taps on tick latency covered, given every write waits in one store-wide queue: does SC-002 hold for a tap made while earlier saves are still queued? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Research §R9]

## Non-Functional Boundaries

- [x] CHK027 - Are memory use, battery use and install size intentionally left without targets, and is that exclusion recorded? [Gap, Boundary]
- [x] CHK028 - Is the cost of `synchronous = FULL` ("a few milliseconds on the reference phones") stated as an assumption to be checked, with what happens if it delays non-tick actions noticeably? [Assumption, Research §R4]
- [x] CHK029 - Is the trigger for replacing `SectionList` with FlashList ("if profiling shows lag") tied to a measurable threshold, such as SC-008 missed on a reference phone? [Clarity, Research §R11]

## Acceptance and Regression

- [x] CHK030 - Is it stated what happens when SC-001, SC-002 or SC-008 is missed on one reference phone (release blocked, recorded in the pull request, or accepted), as research R13 does for SC-010? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK031 - Is it stated whether performance is checked only before release by hand, or whether some guard runs earlier (the T129 re-render test, a CI check), and which regressions each one is meant to catch? [Coverage, Tasks §T129, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK032 - Are the results of each performance measurement required to be recorded somewhere (pull request test plan, per phone and per criterion), so a later release can be compared with it? [Gap, Traceability, Tasks §T137]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
